description: Atlas of Opportunity SA is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by South Australian Government; MIT bigdata Living Lab. The Atlas presents research on the relationship between community movement patterns, economic growth and mobility. Users can find a wide variety of information about each Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2). The data include information about sociodemographic, economic, spending, and mobility data. Difference indices and prediction measures are provided that could be useful for business owners to make better decisions. Coverage is the states and territories; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: Report (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
